03-19-1390 is March 19, 1390.  
Subtract 268 days:  
1390 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
March 19 minus 268 days:  
Go back 19 days to March 1 (19 days).  
Remaining 268 - 19 = 249 days to subtract from March 1.  
January and February 1390 have 31 + 28 = 59 days.  
March 1 minus 59 days = January 1, 1390.  
Remaining 249 - 59 = 190 days to subtract before January 1, 1390.  
190 days into previous year 1389 (common year):  
From December 31, 1389, go back:  
December: 31 days, November: 30, October: 31, September: 30, August: 31, July: 31, June: 30.  
Sum: 31+30+31+30+31+31+30 = 214 days back to June 17, 1389 (since 214 - 190 = 24 days into June: June 30 - 24 = June 6? Wait, check carefully).  

Better: Count back 190 days from January 1, 1390:  
Jan 1 → Dec 31, 1389 is 1 day back (Dec 31).  
Need 189 more days back from Dec 31, 1389.  
December 1389: 31 days total, so Dec 31 minus 31 days = Nov 30.  
189 - 31 = 158 days left.  
November: 30 days → Nov 30 minus 30 = Oct 31. 158 - 30 = 128 left.  
October: 31 days → Oct 31 minus 31 = Sep 30. 128 - 31 = 97 left.  
September: 30 days → Sep 30 minus 30 = Aug 31. 97 - 30 = 67 left.  
August: 31 days → Aug 31 minus 31 = July 31. 67 - 31 = 36 left.  
July: 31 days → July 31 minus 31 = June 30. 36 - 31 = 5 left.  
June: 30 days → June 30 minus 5 days = June 25.
